description: Which game Gold Skulltula (MapParam CollectSign id) each dungeon marker is, decided by hand: our dungeon markers had placeholder positions, so they can't be matched by distance. Reasons come from the objects beside each skulltula in zeldamods' Owl Object Map data and the floor artwork.
